description: Server-to-server post-install events posted as JSON to control.kochava.com/track/json.

params.name: kochava_app_id
params.description: It is the Kochava app GUID, and the S2S event article requires it on every post-install payload.
params.fix_hint: Set `kochava_app_id` to the app GUID from the Kochava dashboard.

params.name: action
params.description: It names the S2S call. The post-install event article's sample sends `event`.
params.fix_hint: Set `action` to `event` for a post-install event.

params.name: kochava_device_id
params.description: The article requires the `kochava_device_id` key on every post-install payload. The value may be empty when `device_ids` carries an ID instead.
params.fix_hint: Send `kochava_device_id` as a stable per-install string, or send it empty and put an ID in `device_ids`.

params.name: data
params.description: Kochava documents a `data` object on every post-install event payload.
params.fix_hint: Add a `data` object with `event_name`.

params.name: data.event_name
params.description: It is the event name. The article places `event_name` inside `data`.
params.fix_hint: Set `data.event_name` to the event the marketer expects.

params.name: origination_ip
params.description: It is the device IP. Kochava documents `origination_ip` as required; the field table puts it at the root and the samples put it inside `data`.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IP as `origination_ip` or `data.origination_ip`.

params.name: data.origination_ip
params.description: It is the device IP inside `data`, which is where Kochava's JSON samples put `origination_ip`.
params.fix_hint: Send the device IP as `data.origination_ip` or `origination_ip`.

params.name: device_ua
params.description: It is the device user agent. Kochava documents `device_ua` as required so it can parse the OS version.
params.fix_hint: Send the client user agent as `device_ua` or `data.device_ua`.

params.name: data.device_ua
params.description: It is the device user agent inside `data`, which is where Kochava's JSON samples put `device_ua`.
params.fix_hint: Send the client user agent as `data.device_ua` or `device_ua`.

params.name: device_ver
params.description: It is the device version string. Kochava documents the key as required and allows an empty value when `device_ua` is sent instead.
params.fix_hint: Send `device_ver` or `data.device_ver`. An empty string is valid.

params.name: data.device_ver
params.description: It is the device version string inside `data`. Kochava's samples send `device_ver` as an empty string.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ver` or `device_ver`. An empty string is valid.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code on revenue events. Kochava's samples send `USD`.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: data.currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code inside `data`. Kochava's samples send `USD`.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: usertime
params.description: It is the time the user completed the event, as Unix seconds.
params.fix_hint: Send `usertime` as seconds since epoch.

params.name: data.usertime
params.description: It is the time the user completed the event, as Unix seconds inside `data`.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.usertime` as seconds since epoch.

params.name: data.app_version
params.description: It is the app version string. Kochava documents `app_version` as optional.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.app_version` as a version string such as `1.0.0`, or drop the pair.

params.name: data.device_ids.idfa
params.description: It is the iOS advertising ID inside `device_ids`. Kochava requires at least one identifier in that object.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ids.idfa`, or another documented identifier such as `adid` or `android_id`.

params.name: data.device_ids.idfv
params.description: It is the iOS vendor ID inside `device_ids`. Kochava allows more than one identifier.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ids.idfv` when it is available.

params.name: data.device_ids.adid
params.description: It is the Android advertising ID inside `device_ids`. Kochava requires at least one identifier in that object.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ids.adid`, or another documented identifier such as `idfa` or `android_id`.

params.name: data.device_ids.android_id
params.description: It is the Android ID inside `device_ids`. Kochava requires at least one identifier in that object.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.device_ids.android_id`, or another documented identifier such as `idfa` or `adid`.

params.name: device_ids.idfa
params.description: It is the iOS advertising ID when `device_ids` sits at the root. Kochava's table lists the object alongside other required keys.
params.fix_hint: Send `device_ids.idfa`, or put the object inside `data`.

params.name: device_ids.idfv
params.description: It is the iOS vendor ID when `device_ids` sits at the root.
params.fix_hint: Send `device_ids.idfv` when it is available.

params.name: device_ids.adid
params.description: It is the Android advertising ID when `device_ids` sits at the root.
params.fix_hint: Send `device_ids.adid`, or put the object inside `data`.

params.name: device_ids.android_id
params.description: It is the Android ID when `device_ids` sits at the root.
params.fix_hint: Send `device_ids.android_id`, or put the object inside `data`.

params.name: data.event_data.id
params.description: It is the item id inside `event_data`. Kochava's post-install sample sends it.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.event_data.id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.event_data.name
params.description: It is the item name inside `event_data`. Kochava's post-install sample sends it.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.event_data.name`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: data.event_data.sum
params.description: It is the monetary value inside `event_data`. Kochava's post-install sample sends a number such as `150`.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.event_data.sum` as a number, with no currency symbol.

params.name: data.att
params.description: It is the iOS App Tracking Transparency result. Kochava documents `true` when tracking is authorized and `false` when it is not, on iOS 14+ events.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.att` as `true` or `false`.

params.name: data.att_detail
params.description: It is the ATTrackingManager.AuthorizationStatus. Kochava documents `authorized`, `denied`, `notDetermined`, and `restricted`.
params.fix_hint: Send `authorized`, `denied`, `notDetermined`, or `restricted`.

params.name: data.app_tracking_transparency.att
params.description: It is the ATT result inside Kochava's iOS 14+ `app_tracking_transparency` object.
params.fix_hint: Send `data.app_tracking_transparency.att` as `true` or `false`.

params.name: data.app_tracking_transparency.att_detail
params.description: It is the ATTrackingManager.AuthorizationStatus inside `app_tracking_transparency`.
params.fix_hint: Send `authorized`, `denied`, `notDetermined`, or `restricted`.

params.name: data.app_tracking_transparency.att_time
params.description: It is the ATT authorization time. Kochava documents `att_time` as optional on iOS 14+ events.
params.fix_hint: Send `att_time` as Unix seconds.

params.name: data.app_tracking_transparency.att_duration
params.description: It is how long the user took to answer the ATT prompt, in seconds.
params.fix_hint: Send `att_duration` as an integer number of seconds.

rules.message: The payload has no device IP. Kochava documents `origination_ip` as required on every post-install event.
rules.fix_hint: Send `origination_ip` at the root or inside `data`.

rules.message: The payload has no device user agent. Kochava documents `device_ua` as required so it can parse the OS version.
rules.fix_hint: Send `device_ua` at the root or inside `data`.

rules.message: The payload has no `device_ver` key. Kochava documents the key as required and allows an empty value.
rules.fix_hint: Send `device_ver` at the root or inside `data`. An empty string is valid.

rules.message: The payload has no identifier in `device_ids`. Kochava requires at least one of IDFA, IDFV, ADID, or Android ID.
This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Kochava documents `origination_ip` and `device_ua` as unhashed device values.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.
